a23fa404-9428-4b98-856f-e8abb6567ad5/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> surveyed the surroundings. <NL>Heavy security was in place, with the guards standing in tight formation. <NL>Charging in blindly would mean being pinned down, with no way out except through a series of {0}...
a23fa404-9428-4b98-856f-e8abb6567ad5/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>细细观察四周，<NL>此处戒备森严，守卫结成阵势，<NL>若要执意横闯，恐会陷入重围，不历经数场{0}，绝难脱身……

3b518188-0b1c-4b31-b40e-3b54e1894935/Eve.en: "What the hell do you think you're doing?!" <NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> ignored the shout, dead set on leaving the warehouse! <NL>But the security is iron-tight, and <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> was quickly drawn into a brutal brawl with the guards!
3b518188-0b1c-4b31-b40e-3b54e1894935/Eve.cn: “阁下何以如此！”<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>并不多言，执意离开库房！<NL>然而此地戒备森严，很快，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>便与守卫之人陷入一场恶斗！

6afb77ac-34ab-4304-9396-4534592caac5/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> defeated all the guards, and<NL>exited the warehouse doors with the "loot"...
6afb77ac-34ab-4304-9396-4534592caac5/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>将守卫尽数打倒，<NL>带着“所取之物”顺利地走出库房大门……
6afb77ac-34ab-4304-9396-4534592caac5/Eve.ru: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> победил всех охранников, и<NL>вышел из дверей Склада с "добычей"...

b87ccb96-a7e2-4133-bdb4-4f2d3ad8f6fc/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> was overwhelmed by numbers. <NL>A moment's carelessness, and the guards surrounded them. <NL>After a desperate struggle, more guards poured in and pinned <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> down. <NL>"You are the Taiwu, and yet you break the law like this? <NL>Today I'll teach you the rules of my <Settlement key=SettlementId str=Name/>!"
b87ccb96-a7e2-4133-bdb4-4f2d3ad8f6fc/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>双拳难敌四手，<NL>一时疏忽竟被守卫团团围住，脱身不得，<NL>几经缠斗，越来越多守卫奔至，将<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>押住，<NL>“阁下既为太吾，如何这般无法乱纪？<NL>今日便教你知道，我<Settlement key=SettlementId str=Name/>的规矩！”

f7aaa9e3-04cf-4111-a26e-0c51ce890bd3/Eve.en: "What the hell do you think you're doing?!" <NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> said nothing more, dead set on leaving the warehouse. <NL>But this place was a fortress—soon, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> was locked in a desperate fight with the guards.

824891f6-fab2-401e-91ee-eca714b0435d/Opt.en: (It was a misunderstanding. I'll put it back...)

59efaf76-0fca-42d9-9f2e-75c7a11cb379/Opt.en: My mistake... I'll take those back with me now.
59efaf76-0fca-42d9-9f2e-75c7a11cb379/Opt.ru: Моя ошибка... Теперь я заберу их обратно с собой.
